description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing performance tracker logs in an HR management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting performance tracker logs, along with associated validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to manage performance tracker logs, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting logs, with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list performance tracker logs, applying filters and pagination, and returning logs with counts of positive and negative achievements.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new performance tracker log, setting parameters such as achievement, comment, log, and associating it with the current user.

methods.name: setTrackerLogsParams
methods.description: Helper method to set log details (log, achievement, comment, status) from request parameters to the PerformanceTrackerLog object.

methods.name: getCommonBodyParamRulesCollection
methods.description: Returns validation rules for request bodies used in create and update methods.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove multiple logs associated with a tracker ID, verifying user permissions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single log by ID, verifying existence and access rights.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing performance tracker log with new data from the request.
